name: dsh-rtl
description: Right-to-left / left-to-right switch for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Adds a Text direction row under Settings > General > Language with three modes (RTL / AUTO / LTR), drives <html dir>, injects a generated RTL override layer, keeps code/terminal/diff/JSON/path panes LTR, and applies idempotent on-disk fixes for the drag handles, timeline scroll and attachment carousel. AUTO keeps the chrome RTL while mostly-English chat blocks, the composer and (optionally) sidebar titles flip themselves to LTR. Its own settings section exposes every knob in seven groups: mode, zones, detection (threshold, min/max letters, mixed text, digits), behaviour (debounce, observer, input, debug), override rules (force LTR/RTL, ignore), selectors (scope, composer, scan, block, island, sidebar) and JSON import/export with a restore-defaults action. Regenerate with install.sh after every Harness update.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && python3 build.py --check
